title: Ghost in the Shell and Jaadugar: A Witch in Mongolia Get Crossover Visual by Science SARU Director
content: A new crossover visual featuring THE GHOST IN THE SHELL and Jaadugar: A Witch in Mongolia has been revealed. Both TV anime are currently airing as part of the Summer 2026 anime season, with animation production handled by Science SARU.

title: Aito Aoyagi's 'Red Riding Hood: A Detective Story' Novel Gets TV Anime in 2027
content: A new official website opened on Monday to announce the television anime of Aito Aoyagi 's Akazukin, Tabi no Tochū de Shitai to Deau ( Red Riding Hood: A Detective Story , or literally Little Red Riding Hood Encounters a Dead Body During Her Journey.) novel, which will debut next year.

title: 'Mushoku Tensei III' Reveals Additional Cast, "Chaos Breaker" Promo
content: The official website for the television anime adaptation of Rifujin na Magonote 's Mushoku Tensei: Isekai Ittara Honki Dasu ( Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation ) light novel revealed additional cast and the "Chaos Breaker" promotional video for the third season on Monday.

title: Little Red Riding Hood Meets a Corpse on Her Journey TV Anime Announced for 2027
content: Aito Aoyagi’s fairy tale mystery novel series Little Red Riding Hood Meets a Corpse on Her Journey ( Akazukin, Tabi no Tochu de Shitai to Deau. ) is getting a TV anime adaptation in 2027. A teaser visual and trailer were revealed, along with the first cast and staff.

title: Mushoku Tensei Season 3 Chaos Breaker Trailer Arc Trailer Revealed, Begins on August 16
content: Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation Season 3 revealed a trailer for the Chaos Breaker arc, which will begin with Episode 8 on August 16. Crunchyroll is streaming the anime as part of its Summer 2026 lineup .
